verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document adaptive quality when bandwidth drops, and it does not document user control over resolution or frame rate. The codec list (VP8/VP9/AV1/H264/H265), the generic "90 options" claim and a community mention of a shrink-to-fit view are adjacent features. None of them is the capability this story asks for, so they earn no credit. Streaming quality is a fair axis for a remote desktop product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
